name: Pasta
intro: Arugula wilts into hot pasta in about five seconds. With lemon and a lot of parmesan, it's the fastest dinner in this edition.
keep: Dried pasta — something short, or spaghetti

variations.context: The base version. Toss the arugula in off the heat so it wilts without cooking.
Loosen a few spoonfuls of the jar with pasta water. A red sauce that isn't tomato.
Richer. The one that eats like a weekend.

works_well_with: White beans, warmed in the oil
finish: Save a mug of pasta water before draining — parmesan and oil need it to become a sauce. Arugula goes in after the heat is off, then lemon, then more parmesan than seems right.
